brief: Checks if an x500Name ends with the RDNs of another
description: Returns true if the RDNs of pattern are the last RDNs of value, compared as x500Name equality compares them. For example, "O=Medico Corp,C=US"x500Name matches "cn=John Smith,o=Medico Corp, c=US"x500Name.

parameters.description: The RDNs value must end with.
parameters.name: pattern

returns.description: True if value ends with the RDNs of pattern.
